blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion.
Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.
The project page is available at https://shenxiaojian.github.io/BeatDance/ .
blocks.zh:
从音乐中产生现实的3D舞蹈是一项挑战性的任务,需要准确与音乐节奏同步,同时捕捉人类运动的空间复杂性. 虽然现有的方法可以产生物理上可行的舞蹈动作,但往往会努力与音乐,如节拍,实现精确的配乐. 为了克服这一局限性,我们提出了一个基于传播的新框架,即BeatDance,其中有两个组成部分: 1) 我们提出了一个分级的脱钩注意力模块,首先将人类姿势和时间动态的学习分开。 然后采用分级结构来捕捉短期和长期的依赖性,从而增强时空模型。 2)我们通过引入辅助舞蹈对音乐模块,采用循环一致的学习. 在训练期间,重建的音乐和原声音乐之间的差异会诱发更强烈的损失信号,有效地鼓励音乐和舞蹈运动之间的一致性属性.
广泛的实验结果表明,我们提议的方法在两个基准数据集上比最近的竞争性方法要好。
项目网页见https://shenxiaojian.github.io/BeatDance/。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Music plays an important role in shaping emotions and narratives, which are often embodied through human motion. This natural connection has inspired growing interest in generating 3D dance conditioned on the music. Automated motion synthesis from music reduces reliance on motion-capture systems and costly animation tools, enabling more efficient content creation across various applications such as film-making [ 7 , 40 ] , virtual production [ 11 ] , and video editing [ 42 , 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 音乐在塑造情感和叙事中扮演重要角色,这些情感和叙事往往通过人类运动来体现. 这种自然的连接激发了人们对产生以音乐为条件的3D舞蹈的兴趣不断增长. 音乐的自动运动合成减少了对动作捕捉系统和昂贵的动画工具的依赖,使得电影制作[7,40],虚拟制作[11],视频编辑[42,37]等各种应用能够更高效地创造内容.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison with the existing state-of-the-art method. (a) POPDG [ 24 ] uses a cross-attention and an alignment module to associate music and dance. However, it may face challenges in achieving beat-level synchronization. (b) We propose Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) and a cycle-consistent learning strategy. HDA hierarchically decouples spatial and temporal information, while cycle-consistent learning leverages the inverse dance-to-music mapping to further enhance temporal alignment.
blocks.zh: 图1:与现有最先进的方法的比较。 (a) POPDG[24] 使用交叉关注和对齐模块来联系音乐和舞蹈。 然而,在实现节拍同步方面可能面临挑战。 (b) 我们提议分级分级注意和周期性学习战略。 HDA在等级上解析了空间和时间信息,而周期相容的学习则利用反向舞蹈对音乐的映射,以进一步加强时间对齐.

blocks.en:
To achieve high-quality dance generation, many works leverage the autoencoder [ 30 , 45 ] as a core component of the model architecture. Bailando [ 31 ] models the upper and lower body motions separately using VQ-VAE, and generates motion code indices auto-regressively. TM2D [ 5 ] combines the training of music-to-dance and text-to-motion, which helps produce smoother dance motion.
Recently, diffusion models have shown remarkable proficiency in music-driven 3D dance generation [ 49 , 19 , 18 , 38 ] .
For example, EDGE [ 35 ] proposes to use Jukebox [ 3 ] to extract music features, and the model also supports dance editing, dance completion, and joint in-painting.
POPDG [ 24 ] proposes a new dataset, i.e ., PopDanceSet, which comprises a wide range of diverse and complex dance motions. It introduces an additional self-attention and an alignment module to learn the relationships among human body parts and insert music features into the model, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了实现高品质的舞蹈一代,许多作品将自动编码器[30,45]作为模型建筑的核心组成部分加以利用. Bailando [31] 分别使用 VQ-VAE 模拟上下身运动,并自动生成运动码指数. TM2D[5]结合了音乐对舞和文字对动作的训练,有助于产生更平滑的舞蹈动作.
最近,传播模式在音乐驱动的3D舞蹈生成中表现出了卓越的熟练程度[49,19,18,38].
例如,EDGE [35] 建议使用Jukebox [3] 来提取音乐特征,该模型还支持舞蹈编辑,舞蹈完成,以及联合内绘.
POPDG [24] 提出了一个新的数据集,即PopDanceSet,它包含广泛的多样和复杂的舞蹈动作. 它引入了一个额外的自我关注和调整模块,以学习人体各部分之间的关系,并在模型中分别插入音乐特征.

blocks.en:
Despite the encouraging progress, these methods still face challenges in generation precision.
First, they only perform a coarse-grained fusion of music and motion features without explicitly modeling the spatial-temporal dependencies simultaneously between music and dance, which lead to beat misalignment (such as POPDG illustrated in Figure 1 (a)). Second, these works typically focus on long-term dependency, overlooking the short-term patterns that are crucial for maintaining motion continuity and synchronizing with local-level musical beats.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了令人鼓舞的进展,但这些方法在准确生成方面仍然面临挑战。
首先,他们只进行粗糙的音乐和运动特征的组合,而没有明确同时模拟音乐和舞蹈之间的时空依赖性,这导致了节拍错配(如图1(a)所示的POPDG). 其次,这些作品通常侧重于长期依赖,忽略了对保持运动连续性和与地方音乐节奏同步至关重要的短期模式.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we propose BeatDance, a diffusion-based framework for music-driven 3D dance generation.
At the core of this framework is our proposed Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA), which consists of two components.
First, we present a decoupled attention that explicitly separates the learning of spatial and temporal information. Specifically, the spatial attention divides the body into several anatomical parts, each with an independent linear projection. For the temporal dynamics, we update the temporal feature by applying a Taylor series expansion over a learned joint music-dance attention map. Second, we employ a hierarchical design that organizes these motion features from local to global levels for short-term and long-term dependencies. This design provides the capacity to model fine-grained music-dance correspondences across multiple temporal scales.
Meanwhile, to further exploit this capacity, we introduce a dance-to-music branch based on a latent diffusion model. We perform cycle-consistent learning to map dance motion back to its corresponding music, which improves the alignment between the two modalities. The improved music-dance alignment is particularly reflected in more accurate beat synchronization. It also benefits broader aspects of dance quality: the part-specific spatial modeling facilitates the learning of complex dance poses and expressive whole-body movements, while the short-term and long-term temporal modeling promote smooth transitions and choreographic coherence, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些局限,我们提议BeatDance,一个基于传播的框架,用于音乐驱动的3D舞蹈生成.
这个框架的核心是我们提议的分级脱钩关注(HDA),它由两个部分组成.
首先,我们提出一种分散的注意,明确区分空间和时间信息的学习。 具体来说,空间注意将身体分为几个解剖部分,每个部分都有独立的线性投影. 对于时间动态,我们通过应用泰勒系列的扩展来更新时间特征,比起学习的音乐-舞蹈联合关注地图. 第二,我们采用一种分级设计,从地方到全球各级为短期和长期依赖组织这些运动特征。 这种设计提供了在多个时间尺度上建模精致的音乐舞蹈对应的能力.
同时,为了进一步挖掘这种能力,我们采用了基于潜在扩散模式的舞蹈对音乐分支。 我们进行循环一致的学习,将舞蹈运动映射回对应的音乐,这改善了两种方式的配合. 改进后的音乐舞曲配合特别体现在更准确的节拍同步上. 这也有利于舞蹈质量的更广泛的方面:部分特定的空间模型促进学习复杂的舞蹈姿势和表现的全身运动,而短期和长期的时间模型则分别促进平稳过渡和舞蹈的一致性.

blocks.en: Taking these components together, our approach is able to generate expressive, smooth, and choreographically coherent dance motions that are well synchronized with the music, particularly aligning closely with the underlying beat (as shown in Figure 1 (b)). We conduct extensive experiments on two datasets, PopDanceSet and AIST++. For example, on the PopDanceSet dataset, BeatDance achieves a PBC of 7.91 and BAS of 0.244, outperforming POPDG of 5.95 and 0.233, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法将这些组成部分结合在一起,就能够产生与音乐完全同步的表达性、光滑性和舞蹈一致性运动,尤其是与基本节拍紧密配合(见图1(b))。 我们在PopDanceSet和AIST++两个数据集上进行了广泛的实验. 例如,在PopDanceSet数据集上,BeatDance实现7.91的PBC和0.244的BAS,表现分别超过5.95和0.233的POPDG.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions include: 1. We present BeatDance, a diffusion-based framework for music-driven 3D dance generation that achieves state-of-the-art physical plausibility and beat alignment on both benchmarks, while maintaining competitive motion diversity. 2. We propose a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA), which separately models motion spatial structures and temporal dynamics. It also incorporates a hierarchical architecture to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies between the music and dance. 3. We introduce a cycle-consistent learning framework by predicting music features from generated dance motion through a dance-to-music module, which further enhances alignment with the musical beat.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献包括: 1. 我们介绍BeatDance,这是一个基于传播的基于音乐驱动的3D舞蹈生成框架,它能实现最先进的物理可信度,并在两个基准上保持一致,同时保持竞争性运动的多样性。 2. 我们提议建立分级的分级注意(HDA),分别模拟空间结构和时间动态。 它还包含一种分级结构,以捕捉音乐与舞蹈之间的短期和长期依赖关系. 3. 我们采用循环一致的学习框架,通过舞蹈对音乐模块预测产生舞蹈运动的音乐特征,这进一步加强了与音乐节拍的配合。

blocks.zh: 我们提出BeatDance,这是音乐驱动的3D舞蹈生成的传播框架,它实现了最先进的物理可信度,并在两个基准上击败对齐,同时保持了竞技运动的多样性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: In this section, we review works closely related to ours in two areas. We first discuss text-driven motion generation, which shares similar architectural foundations with our approach. We then review music-driven dance generation, with a focus on recent diffusion-based methods and their limitations in achieving precise cross-modal alignment.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们回顾两个领域与我们的工作密切相关。 我们首先讨论由文字驱动的运动生成,这种生成与我们的方法具有类似的建筑基础。 然后,我们审查音乐驱动的舞蹈生成,重点是最近的传播方法及其在实现精确的跨模式组合方面的局限性。

blocks.en: 2.1 Text-Driven Motion Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 文本驱动运动生成

blocks.en:
Text-driven motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motion from a text description.
Early works [ 28 , 8 ] directly deploy a text encoder and a motion decoder to learn the mapping from the two modalities.
Recently, some works [ 23 , 29 ] employ a Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) [ 36 ] to project human motions into discrete representations.
For example, T2M-GPT [ 51 ] encodes motion sequences into discrete tokens using VQ-VAE and then learns to map text descriptions to these tokens with a Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT).
Another trend is the use of diffusion models for motion synthesis. MotionDiffuse [ 52 ] and MDM [ 34 ] are among the first efforts to apply diffusion models [ 9 ] to this field.
Subsequent works achieve performance improvements by encoding the motion into latent space [ 55 , 47 , 12 ] , adopting a retrieval-augmented generation strategy [ 53 ] , and exploring spatial-temporal decoupled attention [ 1 , 46 , 25 , 41 , 48 , 43 , 4 ] .
For example, MLD [ 2 ] learns low-dimensional latent vectors of a motion sequence with a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). Then, it employs a latent diffusion model to generate latent vectors from text. FineMoGen [ 54 ] proposes a spatio-temporal mixture attention to separately model spatial and temporal dependencies. Although it shares a related modeling principle with our method, our work focuses on the distinct challenge of fine-grained music-dance alignment: the generated dance should respond to rapidly changing local rhythmic patterns while maintaining long-term motion coherence. To address this challenge, our HDA explicitly models fine-grained relationships between the two modalities and hierarchically captures short-term rhythmic patterns and long-term dependencies.
Furthermore, we propose a cycle-consistent training paradigm that further improves the music-dance alignment.
blocks.zh:
文本驱动运动生成旨在从文本描述中合成现实的人类运动.
早期作品[28,8]直接部署文本编码器和运动解码器,从两种模式学习绘图.
最近,一些作品[23,29]使用矢量量化变异自动编码器(VQ-VAE)[36]将人类运动投射成离散的表示.
例如,T2M-GPT[51]将运动序列编码成使用VQ-VAE的离散符号,然后学习用Generative Pretrained Transformer(GPT)将文字描述映射到这些符号上.
另一个趋势是运动合成使用扩散模型. 运动Diffuse[52]和MDM[34]是在这一领域应用传播模型的首批努力之一。
随后的作品通过将运动编码为潜在空间[55,47,12],采用检索-增强生成策略[53],并探索空间-时空脱钩注意[1,46,25,41,48,43,4],实现了性能改进.
例如,MLD[2]用变异自动编码器(VAE)来学习运动序列的低维潜在向量. 然后,它使用潜在扩散模型从文本中生成潜在矢量。 FineMoGen [54]提议对单模式的空间和时间依赖性进行spatio-时态混合关注. 虽然它与我们的方法有着一个相关的建模原则,但我们的工作重点是精细的音乐舞调配合的显著挑战:产生的舞蹈应该对迅速变化的当地节奏规律作出反应,同时保持长期的运动一致性. 为了应对这一挑战,我们人力开发局明确模式了两种模式之间的精细关系,并分级捕捉了短期节奏模式和长期依赖关系。
此外,我们提议采用循环一致的培训模式,进一步改善音乐舞蹈的配合。

blocks.en: 2.2 Music-Driven Dance Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 音乐驱动器 舞蹈生成

blocks.en:
Music-driven dance generation is challenging due to its demand for complex articulation and precise music-dance alignment.
Early methods [ 17 , 27 ] , which rely on similarity-based retrieval and concatenation from existing databases, are inherently limited in generating novel dance motions.
With the advent of deep learning, extensive efforts [ 39 , 10 , 21 , 15 ] have been made to model the probabilistic mapping between music and dance.
Among these advances, VQ-VAEs have emerged as an effective tool for learning discrete motion representations.
For example, Bailando [ 31 , 32 ] encodes motion into discrete codes and uses a GPT-style autoregressive decoder to generate upper- and lower-body movements, with a reinforcement-learning-based scheme for beat alignment.
Similarly, TM2D [ 5 ] utilizes a shared VQ-VAE codebook for both music-to-dance and text-to-motion tasks. By unifying the shared latent space, it benefits from large-scale text-motion datasets, resulting in smoother dance motions.
More recently, diffusion models have shown remarkable proficiency in music-driven 3D dance generation [ 49 , 38 , 50 ] , branching into two distinct research directions.
One direction focuses on extremely long dance generation via multi-stage architectures [ 19 , 18 ] . For example, Lodge [ 19 ] employs a coarse-to-fine framework to achieve this through cascaded generation processes. Different from these multi-stage approaches, our HDA captures short-term and long-term dependencies within a unified single-stage module, with a particular focus on improving fine-grained music-dance alignment.
The other direction explores single-stage frameworks to streamline the generation pipeline.
EDGE [ 35 ] is the first to leverage the diffusion model for synthesizing high-fidelity dance in this category.
It uses Jukebox [ 3 ] to extract music features, which has become the standard setting for subsequent works.
POPDG [ 24 ] proposes PopDanceSet, a dataset of diverse and complex dance motions. It also introduces spatial-temporal attention blocks and an alignment module that modulates dance features through an affine transformation conditioned on music and motion features. By contrast, our HDA explicitly models fine-grained music-dance correspondences. It first partitions the body into anatomical regions with independent projections, allowing different body parts to separately capture their relationships with the music. It then constructs a joint music-dance attention map and leverages a higher-order Taylor expansion to model complex temporal dynamics. Furthermore, the hierarchical design captures short-term rhythmic patterns and long-term dependencies, enabling the generated motion to respond to local musical beats while maintaining coherent whole-body dynamics. Therefore, while POPDG fuses music and dance features through an affine modulation of dance features, HDA explicitly models how the relationships between music and different body parts evolve across multiple temporal scales.
blocks.zh:
音乐驱动的舞蹈生成因其对复杂表达和精确的音乐舞调调的需求而具有挑战性.
早期的方法[17,27],依靠从现有数据库中基于相似性的检索和调适,在产生新颖的舞蹈动作方面固有的局限性.
随着深入学习的到来,已经做出了广泛的努力[39,10,21,15]来模拟音乐与舞蹈之间的概率制图.
在这些进步中,VQ-VAE已经成为学习离散运动表达的有效工具.
例如,Bailando [31,32] 将运动编码为离散代码,并使用GPT式的自动递归解码器来产生上下体运动,同时采用增强学习制式的节拍对齐方案.
同样,TM2D [5] 也使用共享的VQ-VAE编码本来完成音乐对舞和文字对动的任务. 通过统一共享的潜伏空间,它得益于大规模文字运动数据集,从而产生更平滑的舞蹈动作.
最近,传播模式在音乐驱动的3D舞蹈生成[49,38,50]中表现出了卓越的熟练度,分化成两个截然不同的研究方向.
一个方向侧重于通过多阶段建筑[19,18]进行极长的舞蹈创作. 例如,Lodge[19]采用粗细至细框架,通过级联生成过程实现这一点。 与这些多阶段方法不同,我们的HDA在统一的单阶段模块中捕捉短期和长期的依赖性,尤其注重改进精细的音乐舞曲配乐.
另一个方向是探索单阶段框架,以简化发电管道。
EDGE [35] 是第一个利用传播模型来合成这一类的高纯度舞蹈的.
它使用Jukebox [3] 来提取音乐特征,这已经成为后续作品的标准设定.
POPDG [24] 提出PopDanceSet,一个由多种复杂的舞蹈动作组成的数据集. 它还引入了空间-时空关注块和一个对齐模块,通过以音乐和运动特征为条件的亲缘转换来调节舞蹈特征. 相比之下,我们的HDA明确 模式精致的音乐舞蹈通信。 它首先将身体分割成具有独立预测的解剖区域,使得不同的身体部分能够分别捕捉它们与音乐的关系. 随后,它构建了联合音乐-舞蹈关注地图,并利用更高顺序的泰勒扩展来模拟复杂的时间动态. 此外,分级设计还抓住了短期节奏规律和长期依赖性,使得产生的运动能够响应当地的音乐节奏,同时保持连贯的全身动态. 因此,虽然PPDG通过对舞蹈特征的芬芳调制来引导音乐和舞蹈特征,但HDA明确模拟音乐和不同身体部分之间的关系如何在多个时间尺度上演化.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en:
Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) [ 9 ] are a class of generative models that learn to synthesize data by reversing a gradual noising process.
In this section, we briefly review the key concepts of DDPM that form the foundation of our framework.

在本节中,我们简要回顾了作为我们框架基础的《德班宣言和行动纲领》的关键概念。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we first introduce BeatDance, a diffusion-based framework designed to synthesize realistic and expressive 3D dance sequences that are consistent with the source music. Then we present Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA), which is used to model the intricate spatial-temporal mappings between generated dance and input music, capturing both short-term and long-term dependencies in a hierarchical fashion. Finally, we propose Cycle-Consistent Learning (CCL) mechanism to reinforce the music-dance consistency by employing an auxiliary dance-to-music model.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先介绍BeatDance,这是一个基于扩散的框架,旨在合成符合源音乐的现实和表现的3D舞蹈序列. 然后,我们介绍分级的脱钩关注(HDA),它被用来模拟生成的舞蹈和输入音乐之间的复杂空间-时空映射,以分级的方式捕捉短期和长期的依赖。 最后,我们提议采用循环-一致学习(CCL)机制,通过使用辅助舞蹈对音乐模式来加强音乐-舞蹈的一致性。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of BeatDance. Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) employs a hierarchical design to capture both short-term and long-term music-dance dependencies, building upon a Decoupled Attention (DA) that splits the modeling into spatial and temporal branches. Additionally, our cycle-consistent learning mechanism uses an auxiliary Dance-to-Music (D2M) model to reconstruct the source music features from the generated dance, thereby enforcing a tighter music-dance alignment.
blocks.zh: 图2:BeatDance概况. 分级的脱钩注意力(HDA)采用分级设计,捕捉短期和长期的音乐舞曲依赖性,基于将模型分为空间和时间分支的脱钩注意力(DA). 此外,我们的循环一致的学习机制使用辅助的Dance-to-Music(D2M)模式,从生成的舞蹈中重建源音乐特征,从而实施更紧凑的音乐舞调对调.

blocks.en: The overall architecture is shown in Figure 2 , which consists of a Music-to-Dance (M2D) model and a Dance-to-Music (D2M) model. We adopt a skeleton-based diffusion architecture for the former, which is trained from scratch with music as the conditioning input. The latter is used to reconstruct the music from the generated dance.

blocks.en: Specifically, in the music-to-dance branch, we follow the standard music-driven 3D dance generation setting to use Jukebox [ 3 ] to extract the music embedding from a piece of music. Given a music embedding 𝑴 = [ 𝒎 1 , 𝒎 2 , ⋯ , 𝒎 T ] {\bm{M}}=[{\bm{m}}^{1},{\bm{m}}^{2},\cdots,{\bm{m}}^{T}] and a dance motion sequence 𝑿 = [ 𝒙 1 , 𝒙 2 , ⋯ , 𝒙 T ] {\bm{X}}=[{\bm{x}}^{1},{\bm{x}}^{2},\cdots,{\bm{x}}^{T}] , where 𝒎 i ∈ ℝ 1 × d m {\bm{m}}^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times d_{m}} , 𝒙 i ∈ ℝ 1 × d x {\bm{x}}^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times d_{x}} , T T is the length, which is common to both the music feature and the dance sequence. We employ a diffusion-based model to learn the mapping from the music embedding to the corresponding dance motion. In the forward process, noise ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1) is incrementally added to the dance sequence, obtaining 𝑿 t = α t ​ 𝑿 0 + 1 − α t ​ ϵ {\bm{X}}_{t}=\sqrt{\alpha_{t}}{\bm{X}}_{0}+\sqrt{1-\alpha_{t}}\epsilon at timestep t t . Then, we feed 𝑿 t {\bm{X}}_{t} into a transformer-based denoising autoencoder ϵ θ s \epsilon_{\theta}^{s} to predict the original dance sequence conditioned on 𝑴 {\bm{M}} . The model ϵ θ s \epsilon_{\theta}^{s} incorporates a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) mechanism, which separately models spatial (pose-wise) and temporal dependencies in a hierarchical fashion. This mechanism facilitates the learning of fine-grained correlations between music and dance and enhances the beat alignment (Section 4.2 ). The optimization of ϵ θ s \epsilon_{\theta}^{s} is performed using ℒ m2d \mathcal{L}_{\text{m2d}} , which can be written as ℒ m2d = ℒ diff + λ vlb ​ ℒ vlb + λ va ​ ℒ va + λ joint ​ ℒ joint + λ body ​ ℒ body , \mathcal{L}_{\text{m2d}}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{diff}}+\lambda_{\text{vlb}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{vlb}}+\lambda_{\text{va}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{va}}+\lambda_{\text{joint}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{joint}}+\lambda_{\text{body}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{body}}, where ℒ diff = 𝔼 𝑿 , 𝑴 , ϵ , t ​ [ ‖ 𝑿 − ϵ θ s ​ ( 𝑿 t , t , 𝑴 ) ‖ 2 2 ] \mathcal{L}_{\text{diff}}=\mathbb{E}_{{\bm{X}},{\bm{M}},\epsilon,t}\Big[\|{\bm{X}}-\epsilon_{\theta}^{s}({\bm{X}}_{t},t,{\bm{M}})\|_{2}^{2}\Big] . Following [ 35 , 24 ] , we also use three Mean Squared Error (MSE) losses, i.e ., ℒ va \mathcal{L}_{\text{va}} , ℒ joint \mathcal{L}_{\text{joint}} , and ℒ body \mathcal{L}_{\text{body}} . These losses respectively constrain velocity and acceleration, encourage the consistency in joint space, and enhance ground contact for feet, hands, and the neck. λ va \lambda_{\text{va}} , λ joint \lambda_{\text{joint}} and λ body \lambda_{\text{body}} are hyperparameters that balance the weight of each loss.

blocks.en: 4.2 Hierarchical Decoupled Attention

blocks.en: Different from using cross-attention and alignment modules that jointly model spatial and temporal information, we propose a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA), which explicitly disentangles spatial and temporal modeling (Decoupled Attention) and captures both short-term and long-term dependencies (Hierarchical Mechanism).

blocks.en: 4.3 Cycle-Consistent Learning Mechanism
blocks.zh: 4.3 循环学习机制

blocks.en: The Cycle-Consistent Learning (CCL) mechanism incorporates a dance-to-music model to enhance temporal consistency between the generated dance sequences and the source music. The motivation is that a high-quality music-driven dance should preserve the information in the source music that is visually reflected by motion, such as rhythmic accents, temporal structure, and motion-related musical semantics. If the generated dance loses these music-related cues, the auxiliary D2M model cannot reconstruct the corresponding music features well. Therefore, reconstructing music features from generated motion provides a direct cross-modal supervision signal, encouraging the dance to preserve music-related information and remain aligned with the input music. Notably, we reconstruct music features rather than raw audio, because music features provide a compact and motion-relevant target while avoiding acoustic details that are weakly reflected by body motion. To achieve this, this mechanism employs an auxiliary task that first generates dance motion from input music, then reconstructs the music features from the generated dance with the dance-to-music model.
blocks.zh: Cycle-Consistent Learning(CCL)机制包含了舞蹈对音乐模式,以增强生成的舞蹈序列和源音乐之间的时间一致性. 动机是高品质的音乐驱动的舞蹈应保留源音乐中通过运动视觉反应的信息,如节奏口音,时间结构,以及与运动相关的音乐语义. 如果生成的舞蹈失去了这些与音乐相关的提示,辅助D2M模型无法很好地重建相应的音乐特征. 因此,从产生的运动中重建音乐特征,提供了直接的跨模式监督信号,鼓励舞蹈保存音乐相关信息,并保持与输入音乐的一致. 值得注意的是,我们重建了音乐特征,而不是原始音频,因为音乐特征提供了一个紧凑和运动相关的目标,同时避免音响细节被身体运动弱化反映. 为了实现这个目标,这个机制采用了一个辅助任务,首先从输入音乐中产生舞蹈运动,然后用舞蹈对音乐模式重建所生成的舞蹈中的音乐特征.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments

blocks.en: In this section, we present a comprehensive evaluation of BeatDance. We first describe the experimental settings, including the datasets, implementation details, and evaluation metrics used throughout our evaluation. We then compare our method against state-of-the-art approaches through both quantitative and qualitative analysis. Finally, we conduct ablation studies to analyze the contribution of each proposed component.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Datasets

AIST++ [ 20 ] is a large-scale 3D dance motion dataset
reconstructed from multi-view dance videos.
It contains 1,408 sequences with a total duration of 5.2 hours, covering
10 genres of street dance performed by 30 subjects.
The genres span both old-school styles (Break, Pop, Lock, and Waack)
and new-school styles (Middle Hip-hop, LA-style Hip-hop, House, Krump,
Street Jazz, and Ballet Jazz).
Each genre contains both basic (85%) and advanced (15%) choreographies.
The accompanying music spans tempos from 80 to 135 BPM.
Per-frame annotations include SMPL pose parameters for 24 joints with
global translation, and 17 COCO-format joint locations in both 2D and 3D.
The dataset is carefully split to ensure no overlap of music or
choreography between training and test sets.
Following [ 35 ] , we adopt the same split and preprocessing,
adjusting all training samples to 5 seconds at 30 fps.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Implementation Details

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted on 4 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs.
Our framework consists of two branches: the music-to-dance (M2D) generation branch and the auxiliary dance-to-music (D2M) branch used for cycle-consistent learning.
We describe the implementation details of each branch below.

我们叙述以下每个分支的执行细节。

blocks.en:
The dance feature vector comprises 156 dimensions: a 3-dimensional root joint translation, 6-DoF rotations for 24 SMPL body joints (144 dimensions in total), and 9 binary contact indicators for the feet, hands, and neck.
For the Hierarchical Decoupled Attention module, the 24 body joints are partitioned into N s = 8 N_{s}{=}8 groups: 7 functionally relevant regions incorporating the head, spine, left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, and root joint, along with an additional global full-body part.
Each group is processed by an independent linear projection to preserve part-specific motion characteristics.

每个组由独立的线性投影处理,以保留部分特定运动特性.

These embeddings encode rich semantic and rhythmic information from the raw audio, providing a strong conditioning signal for the M2D generation branch.
All music clips are processed at 30 fps to match the dance frame rate, yielding 150 frames per 5-second clip.

我们使用预训的JUKEBox[3]模型来提取音乐特征,每个帧输出4,800维的嵌入.
这些嵌入式编码了来自原始音频的丰富的语义和节奏信息,为M2D生成分支提供了强大的条件信号.
所有音乐片段均以30 fps处理,以配合舞蹈帧率,每5秒产生150帧.

blocks.en:
The M2D diffusion model adopts a cosine-based variance schedule with a cosine offset of 0.008 and sets the total denoising steps T T to 1000.
The denoising network is a 6-layer Transformer with latent dimensions of 8 × 64 8{\times}64 , where 8 corresponds to the number of body parts and 64 is the per-part feature dimensionality.
The local hierarchical window size τ \tau is set to 30 frames, and the Taylor series expansion order for the temporal attention map is set to 3, both determined through ablation studies (Table 4 and Table 5 ).
During training, we use the Adan [ 44 ] optimizer with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2{\times}10^{-4} , a weight decay of 0.02, and a batch size of 128.
During inference, we employ DDIM sampling with 50 steps, which reduces inference time by 20 × 20{\times} relative to standard DDPM sampling while maintaining comparable generation quality.
blocks.zh:
M2D扩散模型采用以余弦为基础的差异表,余弦抵消0.008,并将总调值步骤T T 到 1000.
消音网络是一个6层的变形器,潜伏的维度为8×64 8×time}64,其中8与身体部位数对应,64是每个部分的特征维度.
本地分级窗口大小 \ tau 设置为 30 帧, 时间关注图的泰勒系列扩展顺序设置为 3, 两者均通过消化研究确定(表 4和表 5 ).
在训练期间,我们使用Adan[44]型优化器,学习率为2×10−4 2×Times}10×4}体重衰减0.02,批量尺寸128.
在推论期间,我们采用DDIM取样,共50个步骤,比标准DDPM取样时间减少20×20×时,同时保持可比的生成质量.

blocks.en:
The D2M branch synthesizes audio represented as mel-spectrograms with 256 Mel-frequency bands.
The VAE encoder and decoder each consist of four convolutional blocks for progressive downsampling and upsampling, respectively, compressing the mel-spectrogram into a compact latent representation.
The latent diffusion model adopts a U-Net architecture with a four-layer convolutional encoder and a symmetric four-layer decoder connected via skip connections, enabling multi-scale feature reuse.
For training, we employ the AdamW optimizer [ 22 ] with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1{\times}10^{-4} , a weight decay of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and a batch size of 32.
blocks.zh:
D2M分支合成以mel-光谱表示的音频,有256个mel-频率波段.
VAE编码器和解码器各由四个演化块组成,分别用于渐进式下采样和上采样,将元谱压缩成紧凑的潜态表示.
潜在的扩散模型采用了一个U-Net架构,其中有一个四层的转录编码器和一个对称的四层解码器通过跳过连接连接连接,使得多级特性可以再利用.
在训练方面,我们使用亚当W优化器[22],学习率为1×10−4 1×10×4 10×4}体重衰减为10−6×10×6],批量大小为32.

blocks.en:
The M2D model is the primary focus of this work and is trained with the support of the auxiliary D2M branch via a two-stage procedure.
In the first stage, the D2M branch is pre-trained independently to ensure it can provide reliable cycle-consistency supervision.
In the second stage, its parameters are frozen, and it is used exclusively to provide cycle-consistency supervision for M2D: dance sequences generated by M2D are passed through the frozen D2M branch to reconstruct the source music, and the resulting ℒ cycle \mathcal{L}_{\text{cycle}} is back-propagated to refine the M2D model.
Throughout training, only the M2D parameters are updated.
blocks.zh:
M2D模式是这项工作的主要重点,在辅助D2M分支的支持下通过两阶段程序进行培训.
在第一阶段,D2M分支是经过独立预训的,以确保其能够提供可靠的周期一致性监督.
在第二阶段,它的参数被冷冻,完全用于为M2D提供周期一致性监督:由M2D产生的舞蹈序列通过冷冻的D2M分支来重建源音乐,由此产生的L周期\mathcal{L}_{\text{cycle}被反向宣传以完善M2D模式.
在整个培训过程中,只更新了M2D参数。

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 评价计量

blocks.en:
We follow previous methods [ 35 , 24 ] to evaluate generated dances from three dimensions: physical plausibility (PFC and PBC), diversity (Div k and Div g ), and beat alignment with music (BAS).
These metrics characterize complementary aspects of visual dance quality: PFC and PBC reflect whether the motion appears physically plausible, Div k and Div g reflect the variety of generated movements, and BAS reflects whether visible motion accents follow the musical rhythm. Since no single automatic metric fully captures the perceptual quality of a dance, we interpret them jointly.

这些衡量标准是视觉舞蹈质量的互补方面:PFC和PBC反映运动是否在物理上看起来合理,Div k和Div g反映产生的运动的多样性,BAS反映可见运动口音是否遵循音乐节奏. 由于没有一个单一的自动参数能完全捕捉到舞蹈的感知质量,所以我们共同解释.

blocks.en:
We evaluate diversity from two complementary perspectives: kinematic (Div k ) and geometric (Div g ).
Each score is computed as the average pairwise Euclidean distance between the feature vectors of all generated sequences in the test set, calculated independently on kinematic and geometric features.
Div k measures variation in motion dynamics, such as differences in velocity and acceleration patterns, whereas Div g measures variation in geometric pose and choreographic configurations. Visually, they indicate whether a model generates a broad range of movement styles and body shapes instead of repeatedly producing similar sequences. However, abnormally jittery or distorted motions can also inflate pairwise distances. Therefore, following EDGE [ 35 ] , we regard values close to the ground-truth diversity as preferable to blindly maximizing either score.

我们从两个互补的角度评价多样性:运动(Div k)和几何(Div g )。
每个分数按测试集中所有生成序列的特征矢量之间平均对偶的欧几里得距离计算,根据运动和几何特征独立计算.
Div k测量运动动力学的变化,如速度和加速度模式的差异,而Div g测量几何姿势和舞蹈布局的变化. 在视觉上,它们表明一个模型是否产生广泛的运动风格和身体形状,而不是反复产生类似的序列. 然而,异常的焦躁或扭曲的运动也可能使双向距离变长。 因此,在EDGE [35] 之后,我们认为接近地面真相多样性的价值观比盲目地尽量扩大两个分数更为可取。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 5.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
In this subsection, we compare BeatDance against competitive baselines on two benchmark datasets. We first present quantitative results across all evaluation metrics, followed by qualitative visualizations to illustrate the superiority of our method in generating expressive and beat-consistent dance motions.
For a fair comparison, all methods use the same experimental setting: 4,800-dimensional Jukebox music embeddings per frame, the same 156-dimensional motion representation, and 5-second music and motion sequences sampled at 30 fps. We evaluate all generated motions using the same protocol and metrics described in Section 5.1.3 .
blocks.zh:
在本分节中,我们将BeatDance与两个基准数据集的竞争性基线进行比较。 我们首先提出所有评价指标的量化结果,然后提出定性可视化,以说明我们的方法在产生表达性和节拍一致的舞蹈运动方面的优越性。
为了进行公平比较,所有方法都使用相同的实验环境:4,800维 每个帧的Jukebox音乐嵌入,相同的156维运动表现,以及5秒的音乐和运动序列在30 fps取样. 我们使用第5.1.3节所述的相同规程和衡量标准评估所有产生的动议。

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 量化结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents quantitative evaluation results on the PopDanceSet and AIST++ datasets.
Our method achieves the best results on four of the five metrics on each dataset, including PFC, PBC, and BAS on both datasets. The remaining differences in diversity metrics are discussed below.
blocks.zh:
表1列出了PopDanceSet和AIST++数据集的定量评价结果。
我们的方法在每个数据集的五个度量中,包括PFC,PBC和BAS在两个数据集上的四个度量标准上都取得了最佳结果. 下文将讨论多样性指标方面的其余差异。

blocks.en:
BeatDance achieves state-of-the-art performance in both PFC and PBC on PopDanceSet and AIST++.
Physical plausibility is a foundational criterion in dance generation: motions with foot-sliding artifacts or implausible physical dynamics are immediately perceptible to viewers, rendering them unsuitable regardless of their beat alignment or diversity.
This improvement is driven by HDA and CCL in a complementary fashion. HDA models the fine-grained spatial-temporal structure of human motion. Its spatial branch learns region-specific physical dynamics through independent per-body-part projections. Its hierarchical temporal structure further ensures coherent full-body coordination across multiple scales. CCL additionally discourages physically implausible configurations by constraining the generated motion to remain semantically aligned with the source music. Together, they produce the state-of-the-art PFC and PBC scores across both benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
BeatDance在PPDanceSet和AIST++上都实现了PFC和PBC的先进性能.
物理理性是舞蹈生成中的一项基础标准:带有脚滑的文物或不可信的物理动力运动对观众来说是直接可见的,不管其拍拍的对齐或多样性如何,都使其不合适.
这一改进是人力开发局和CCL以互补方式推动的。 HDA模拟了人类运动的细纹空间-时态结构. 它的空间分支通过独立的每个体段的预测来学习区域特有的物理动力学. 它的分级时间结构进一步确保了多个尺度的一致的全机构协调。 CCL通过限制生成的动向保持与源音乐的同步,还进一步抑制了物理上的不合理配置. 它们合在一起,得出了最先进的全氟化学品和建设和平委员会两个基准的得分。

blocks.en:
BeatDance also achieves state-of-the-art BAS on both PopDanceSet and AIST++.
As the defining objective of music-driven dance generation, beat alignment is indispensable: a dance that fails to respond to the rhythmic structure of the music defeats the fundamental purpose of the task, regardless of its diversity.
This advantage stems from the synergy between HDA and CCL. HDA equips the model with the capacity to learn fine-grained correspondences between musical rhythm and dance motion across multiple temporal scales, which is a prerequisite for precise beat synchronization. CCL then provides a direct optimization signal for this alignment. The music → \to dance → \to music round-trip can only close with low reconstruction error when the generated dance genuinely tracks the rhythmic structure of the source music. Together, the two components enforce beat-level synchronization.
blocks.zh:
BeatDance在PopDanceSet和AIST++上也实现了最先进的BAS.
作为音乐驱动的舞蹈生成的决定性目标,节拍对接是不可或缺的:不响应音乐节奏结构的舞蹈会挫败任务的根本目的,无论它的多样性如何.
这一优势源于HDA和CCL之间的协同作用. HDA使模型具备了学习音乐节奏和舞蹈运动之间跨越多个时间尺度的精细纹理对应的能力,这是精确节拍同步的先决条件. 然后CCL为这种对齐提供直接优化信号. 当生成的舞蹈真正跟踪源音乐的节奏结构时,音乐 ^\to dance →\to music round-trip 只能以低度重建错误关闭. 两个组件一起执行节拍级同步.

blocks.en:
BeatDance achieves the best geometric diversity (Div g ) on PopDanceSet and the best kinematic diversity (Div k ) on AIST++.
Diversity is at best an auxiliary indicator , as pairwise distance can be inflated by physically implausible outlier poses.
A model generating degraded motions may therefore score artificially high on this metric, a phenomenon also noted in prior work [ 24 , 31 ] .
For the two metrics where we do not rank first, the gaps are readily explained.
On PopDanceSet, POPDG achieves a higher Div k than ours (7.13 vs. 5.72 for BeatDance), but this comes at the cost of substantially lower motion quality (PBC 5.95 for POPDG vs. 7.91 for BeatDance) and beat alignment (BAS 0.233 for POPDG vs. 0.244 for BeatDance).
As shown in Figure 3 , POPDG’s generated motions exhibit clear quality issues, including penetration artifacts and distorted poses.
Such implausible poses may partially account for its higher Div k , as outlier motions tend to inflate pairwise distance measures.
On AIST++, our Div g (2.74) is competitive with the leading diffusion-based result (2.80).
The only method that clearly surpasses ours is Bailando, which achieves a Div g of 6.66, but this advantage does not generalize.
Bailando achieves the second-lowest Div g scores on PopDanceSet, suggesting that its high AIST++ diversity may reflect dataset-specific overfitting of its discrete choreographic memory rather than genuine expressive capability.
blocks.zh:
BeatDance在PopDanceSet上实现了最佳几何多样性(Div g),在AIST++上实现了最佳运动多样性(Div k).
多样性充其量是一个辅助指标,因为双向距离可能因物理上难以想象的外形而膨胀。
因此,产生退化运动的模型在这个衡量标准上可能人为得分很高,这一现象在先前的工作中也有所提及[24、31]。
对于我们没有排在首位的两个衡量标准,差距很容易得到解释。
在PopDanceSet上,POPDG实现了比我们更高的Div k(BeatDance的7.13对5.72),但代价是运动质量大大降低(POPDG对7.91对BeatDance的PBC 5.95)和Beat对齐(POPDG的0.233对BeatDance的0.244).
如图3所示,POPDG产生的动作显示出明显的质量问题,包括穿透文物和扭曲的姿势。
这种不可相信的姿势可能部分归因于其较高的Div k ,因为异常运动往往会使双向距离测量值膨胀。
在AIST++上,我们的Div g(2.74)与主要传播结果(2.80)具有竞争力.
唯一明显超越我们的方法是Bailando,它实现了6.66的Div g,但这一优势并没有概括.
Bailando在PopDanceSet上取得了第二低的Div g分数,暗示其高AIST++多样性可能反映数据集特异性地过度匹配其离散的舞蹈记忆,而不是真正的表达能力.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 定性结果

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows the qualitative comparison on the PopDanceSet dataset.
Compared to POPDG [ 24 ] , our method generates more expressive dance motions. We highlight penetration artifacts and distorted motions using red and blue rectangles, respectively. Furthermore, we provide a beat synchronization analysis in Figure 4 . Our model (blue circles) exhibits significantly higher rhythmic consistency than POPDG (green triangles). Specifically, BeatDance captures 5 of 6 musical beats, whereas POPDG only aligns with 2. These results further validate the effectiveness of HDA and CCL, which enhance the dance motion quality and the music-dance consistency, particularly in terms of beat-level alignment.
It is worth noting that Figure 4 is provided only as an illustrative example for an intuitive understanding of beat alignment. The BAS results in Table 1 are computed over the complete test sets, where BeatDance achieves the best performance on both PopDanceSet and AIST++.
Regarding diversity, we observe that even though POPDG scores higher on Div k , the qualitative results in Figure 3 reveal that a portion of its apparent kinematic variety arises from physically implausible configurations ( e.g ., penetration artifacts and distorted limb poses highlighted in red and blue), rather than genuine choreographic diversity. BeatDance, by contrast, maintains consistent limb topology across generated sequences while still producing varied whole-body postures adapted to the input music, suggesting that its lower Div k reflects tighter physical constraints rather than a lack of expressive range.

blocks.en: 5.2.3 User Study
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 用户研究

blocks.en: To complement the objective metrics, we conducted a pairwise user study with 20 participants using samples from the PopDanceSet test set. BeatDance was compared with POPDG and DanceEditor across multiple music clips, yielding 10 comparisons per participant and 200 pairwise judgments in total. Each pair consisted of a BeatDance result and a result from one competing method generated from the same music clip. For each pair, participants selected the dance with better overall quality while considering motion naturalness, expressiveness, and music-motion compatibility. Method identities were hidden, and both the comparison order and the left-right placement of the videos were randomized. As shown in Table 2 , BeatDance was preferred over both competing methods, demonstrating its perceptual advantage in overall dance quality.
blocks.zh: 为了补充客观的衡量标准,我们利用PopDanceSet测试集的样本,对20名参与者进行了双向用户研究。 将BeatDance与POPDG和DanceEditor进行了多段音乐剪辑的比较,对每个参与者进行了10次比较,总共进行了200次对等判断。 每对都包含一个BeatDance结果和一个来自同一音乐片段产生的竞合方法的结果. 对于每对,参与者在考虑运动自然性,表现性,以及音乐动作兼容性的同时,选择了整体质量更好的舞蹈. 方法身份被隐藏起来,视频的比较顺序和左偏右位置均随机排列. 如表2所示,BeatDance胜过两种相互竞争的方法,显示出其在整体舞蹈质量上的认知优势。

blocks.en:
We investigate the effect of the Taylor series expansion order used to approximate the joint music-dance attention map.
As shown in Table 4 , order 3 achieves the best performance across most metrics, including PBC (7.75), Div k (6.78), Div g (6.18), and BAS (0.273).
Lower orders (1 and 2) yield consistently lower BAS (0.229 and 0.242), suggesting that a low-order approximation lacks the capacity to capture the complex non-linear dependencies between music and dance, resulting in weaker beat alignment.
As the order increases beyond 3, performance degrades across most metrics:
PBC drops from 7.75 to 6.43 and BAS from 0.273 to 0.256 at order 5,
indicating that excessively high-order approximations introduce optimization difficulties that impair music-dance correspondence.
Although order 5 achieves the best PFC (1.13), this comes at the cost of significant degradation in all other metrics and therefore does not represent an overall improvement.
We thus adopt order 3 as the default setting.

blocks.en: 5.3.4 Effect of Generative Architecture
blocks.zh: 5.3.4 基因结构的影响

blocks.en: To choose the most appropriate architecture for the dance-to-music branch, we compare two widely used architectures: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) [ 6 ] and Diffusion models [ 9 ] . Each model is evaluated under two settings: operating on raw data and within a VAE [ 14 ] latent space. To evaluate rhythmic consistency and content similarity between the generated music and the ground truth, we adopt four metrics: BAS, BCS (Beats Coverage Score) [ 16 ] , BHS (Beats Hit Score) [ 16 ] , and FAD (Fréchet Audio Distance) [ 13 ] . BCS and BHS evaluate rhythmic fidelity, where BCS measures the difference in total beat count between the synthesized and reference music, and BHS examines their temporal beat alignment. FAD is used to quantify content similarity and overall audio quality. As shown in Table 6 , the VAE + Diffusion configuration achieves the best performance across all metrics, indicating its superior capability in modeling both rhythm and audio content.
blocks.zh: 为了选择舞蹈对音乐分支最合适的建筑,我们比较了两个被广泛使用的建筑: 遗传性反射网络(GAN)[6]和扩散模型[9]. 每个模型在两种情况下进行评估:在原始数据和VAE[14]潜在空间内运行。 为了评价生成的音乐与地面真理之间的节奏一致性和内容相似性,我们采用了四个度量标准:BAS,BCS(Beats覆盖分数)[16],BHS(Beats Hit分数)[16],以及FAD(Fréchet音频距离)[13]. BCS和BHS评价节奏忠贞性,其中BCS测量合成音乐和参考音乐在总拍数上的差别,BHS检查他们的时拍对齐. FAD用来量化内容相似性和整体音频质量. 如表6所示,VAE + 扩散配置在所有度量衡中都取得了最佳性能,表明其在节奏和音频内容的建模上具有优越的能力.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a diffusion-based framework for 3D music-driven dance generation, which comprises a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) and a cycle-consistent learning (CCL) mechanism.
We employ HDA to capture both long-term and short-term dependencies between the source music and the generated dance by explicitly disentangling spatial and temporal modeling.
Additionally, CCL effectively enhances the music-dance consistency by an auxiliary music-to-dance-to-music task.
Consequently, our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets, particularly in physical plausibility and beat alignment.
Extensive experiments also show its superior performance in maintaining beat consistency.
Despite these promising results, BeatDance still has several limitations.
First, the effectiveness of CCL depends on the reliability of the auxiliary D2M
model. Although the D2M model is independently pre-trained and the ablation
study validates the practical benefit of CCL, inaccurate D2M estimation under
challenging music patterns may introduce noisy or biased supervision. Second,
BeatDance may show weaker beat synchronization when the input contains unseen
music genres with highly complex rhythmic patterns. Future work will explore more
robust D2M supervision, explicit style control, and stronger generalization to
complex musical rhythms.
